schema.description: Extract from the financial statements tables only, not from narrative or summary text
schema.name: total_net_sales

subfields.description: Most recent quarter total net sales in millions, as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations table
subfields.name: quarterly_sales

subfields.description: Same quarter prior year total net sales in millions, as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations table
subfields.name: quarterly_prior_year_sales

subfields.description: Year-over-year quarterly sales growth as a percentage, calculated precisely as (current - prior) / prior * 100 using the table values. Do not round. Preserve full floating-point precision (e.g., 10.491230341078248, not 10.49).
subfields.name: quarterly_growth_pct

subfields.description: Full fiscal year total net sales in millions, as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations table
subfields.name: full_year_sales

subfields.description: Prior fiscal year total net sales in millions, as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations table
subfields.name: full_year_prior_year_sales

subfields.description: Year-over-year full year sales growth as a percentage, calculated precisely as (current - prior) / prior * 100 using the table values. Do not round. Preserve full floating-point precision (e.g., 10.990892246666146, not 10.99).
subfields.name: full_year_growth_pct

schema.description: Extract from the financial statements tables only, not from narrative or summary text
schema.name: operating_income

subfields.description: Most recent quarter operating income in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Operations table
subfields.name: quarterly_operating_income

subfields.description: Most recent quarter operating income divided by net sales as a percentage. Do not round. Preserve full floating-point precision (e.g., 11.29068330919315, not 11.29).
subfields.name: quarterly_operating_margin_pct

subfields.description: Full fiscal year operating income in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Operations table
subfields.name: full_year_operating_income

subfields.description: Full fiscal year operating income divided by net sales as a percentage. Do not round. Preserve full floating-point precision (e.g., 10.75194487420038, not 10.75).
subfields.name: full_year_operating_margin_pct

schema.description: Extract from the financial statements tables only, not from narrative or summary text
schema.name: net_income_and_eps

subfields.description: Most recent quarter net income in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Operations table
subfields.name: quarterly_net_income

subfields.description: Most recent quarter basic earnings per share in dollars, from the financial statements table
subfields.name: quarterly_eps_basic

subfields.description: Most recent quarter diluted earnings per share in dollars, from the financial statements table
subfields.name: quarterly_eps_diluted

subfields.description: Full fiscal year net income in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Operations table
subfields.name: full_year_net_income

subfields.description: Full fiscal year basic earnings per share in dollars, from the financial statements table
subfields.name: full_year_eps_basic

subfields.description: Full fiscal year diluted earnings per share in dollars, from the financial statements table
subfields.name: full_year_eps_diluted

schema.description: Extract from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table only
schema.name: cash_flow

subfields.description: Net cash provided by operating activities in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table
subfields.name: operating_cash_flow

subfields.description: Free cash flow in millions, from a supplemental data table only. If no free cash flow line item exists in the document, return 0 — it will be computed in code.
subfields.name: free_cash_flow

schema.description: Extract from the financial statements tables
schema.name: capex

subfields.description: Purchases of property and equipment in millions, from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table. Use the absolute value of the line item labeled 'Purchases of property and equipment' or 'Payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment'. Do not add finance leases or other items.
subfields.name: total_capex

schema.description: Business segment breakdown from the Segment Information table. Each item is one reportable segment. Segments may be defined by business line (e.g. North America, AWS) or by geography (e.g. Americas, Europe) depending on the company.
schema.name: segments

subfields.description: Name of the reportable segment exactly as it appears in the Segment Information table
subfields.name: segment_name

subfields.description: Most recent quarter net sales for this segment in millions, from the segment table
subfields.name: quarterly_net_sales

subfields.description: Same quarter prior year net sales for this segment in millions, from the segment table
subfields.name: quarterly_prior_year_net_sales

subfields.description: Year-over-year quarterly net sales growth for this segment as a percentage
subfields.name: quarterly_yoy_growth_pct

subfields.description: Most recent quarter operating income for this segment in millions, from the segment table
subfields.name: quarterly_operating_income

subfields.description: Most recent quarter segment operating income divided by segment net sales as a percentage
subfields.name: quarterly_operating_margin_pct

subfields.description: This segment's most recent quarter net sales as a percentage of total consolidated net sales
subfields.name: revenue_mix_pct

schema.description: Detailed cash flow and liquidity data from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows and Balance Sheets tables
schema.name: cash_flow_and_liquidity

subfields.description: Capital spending detail from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table
subfields.name: capital_expenditures

subfields.description: Absolute value of purchases of property and equipment (or payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment) in millions, from the cash flow table
subfields.name: purchases_of_property_and_equipment

subfields.description: Property and equipment acquired under finance leases in millions, from the cash flow table or supplemental section. Return 0 if not present.
subfields.name: finance_lease_additions

subfields.description: Proceeds from property and equipment sales and incentives in millions, from the cash flow table. Return 0 if not present.
subfields.name: proceeds_from_asset_sales

subfields.description: Debt repayment activity from the financing activities section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table
subfields.name: debt_repayments

subfields.description: Absolute value of repayments of long-term debt or term debt in millions, from the cash flow table
subfields.name: long_term_debt_repayments

subfields.description: Absolute value of repayments of short-term debt or commercial paper in millions, from the cash flow table. Return 0 if not present.
subfields.name: short_term_debt_repayments

subfields.description: Lease payment obligations from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows table
subfields.name: lease_obligations

subfields.description: Absolute value of principal repayments of finance leases in millions, from the cash flow table. Return 0 if not present.
subfields.name: finance_lease_principal_repayments

subfields.description: Cash paid for operating leases in millions, from the supplemental cash flow section. Return 0 if not present.
subfields.name: operating_lease_payments

subfields.description: Available cash and securities from the Consolidated Balance Sheets table, using the most recent period
subfields.name: liquidity

subfields.description: Cash and cash equivalents in millions, from the most recent balance sheet date
subfields.name: cash_and_equivalents

subfields.description: Current marketable securities in millions, from the most recent balance sheet. Return 0 if not listed separately.
subfields.name: current_marketable_securities

subfields.description: Non-current or long-term marketable securities in millions, from the most recent balance sheet. Return 0 if not listed separately.
subfields.name: non_current_marketable_securities

subfields.description: Total debt (sum of short-term and long-term debt, term debt, and commercial paper) in millions, from the most recent balance sheet
subfields.name: total_debt

schema.description: Forward-looking quantitative guidance for future quarters, from the Financial Guidance or Outlook section of the document. If the document does not contain any forward guidance, set has_guidance to false and leave all other fields null.
schema.name: forward_guidance

subfields.description: True if the document contains explicit quantitative forward guidance (e.g. revenue or operating income ranges for a future quarter). False if no guidance is provided.
subfields.name: has_guidance

subfields.description: The future period the guidance refers to, e.g. 'Q1 2025' or 'FY 2025'. Return empty string if no guidance.
subfields.name: guidance_period

subfields.description: Low end of guided net sales/revenue range in millions. Return 0 if no guidance. Note: if guidance is stated in billions, convert to millions.
subfields.name: revenue_low

subfields.description: High end of guided net sales/revenue range in millions. Return 0 if no guidance. Note: if guidance is stated in billions, convert to millions.
subfields.name: revenue_high

subfields.description: Low end of guided revenue growth as a percentage. Return 0 if not provided.
subfields.name: revenue_growth_low_pct

subfields.description: High end of guided revenue growth as a percentage. Return 0 if not provided.
subfields.name: revenue_growth_high_pct

subfields.description: Low end of guided operating income range in millions. Return 0 if no guidance. Note: if guidance is stated in billions, convert to millions.
subfields.name: operating_income_low

subfields.description: High end of guided operating income range in millions. Return 0 if no guidance. Note: if guidance is stated in billions, convert to millions.
subfields.name: operating_income_high

subfields.description: Expected FX impact amount in millions, if a specific dollar figure is stated. Return 0 if not mentioned. Convert billions to millions.
subfields.name: fx_impact_amount

subfields.description: Expected FX impact in basis points, if stated. Return 0 if not mentioned.
subfields.name: fx_impact_bps

schema.description: Operational KPIs, stock-based compensation, and notable strategic developments
schema.name: key_business_metrics

subfields.description: Stock-based or share-based compensation expense from the financial tables
subfields.name: stock_based_compensation

subfields.description: Most recent quarter total stock-based or share-based compensation expense in millions, from the financial statements or supplemental tables
subfields.name: quarterly_sbc

subfields.description: Same quarter prior year total stock-based or share-based compensation expense in millions
subfields.name: quarterly_prior_year_sbc

subfields.description: Full fiscal year or year-to-date total stock-based or share-based compensation expense in millions. Use the longest period available.
subfields.name: full_year_sbc

subfields.description: Prior full fiscal year or year-to-date total stock-based or share-based compensation expense in millions
subfields.name: full_year_prior_year_sbc

subfields.description: Key operational metrics reported by the company, such as unit growth, customer metrics, seller metrics, employee count, shipping costs, etc. Extract each distinct KPI as a separate item. If the document does not report operational KPIs, return an empty array.
subfields.name: operational_kpis

subfields.description: Name of the KPI exactly as labeled in the document
subfields.name: metric_name

subfields.description: Most recent period value, including units (e.g. '11%', '1,556,000', '$28,549M')
subfields.name: current_value

subfields.description: Year-over-year change if reported (e.g. '2%', '-21%'). Null if not reported.
subfields.name: yoy_change
